visualIntent: Evidence-bearing build operations: observe authority, identify exact artifacts, bound a build, and assemble an escalation packet. The visual language is transparent and structural so it works in light and dark DocC readers without a decorative backplate.
sourceRules: Transparent SVG canvas; no background rectangles, fills, or gradients.
No external resources, scripts, or CSS dependencies.
Connections meet shapes only at intentional endpoints; no accidental stroke intersections.
No embedded text; page headings and explicit alt text carry the words.

pages.concept: Four stations from observation to escalation
Independent Xcode and Swiftly lanes converge only on a diagnosis
Source candidate and installed artifact retain distinct identities at a comparison gate
Repeated samples distinguish active work from a bounded no-progress interval
Five evidence fields compose a non-secret escalation packet

nonClaims: This plan does not prove that the assets resolve in a DocC renderer.
This plan does not prove a repaired installed Vaporize artifact.
This plan does not imply CPO visual approval or human support sign-off.
